name: portkeeper
description: Menu bar / tray gadget that shows open ports and Docker containers, and lets you open, stop or kill them.

scripts.icons: python3 assets/make_icons.py && tauri icon assets/icon.png && python3 assets/make_icons.py ico
scripts.deploy:site: npm run site && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages deploy site --project-name portkeeper --branch main
